title: X-CoSD：跨词表通信高效的协同投机解码
summary: 提出X-CoSD框架，解决异构SLM-LLM词表下的协同投机解码问题。通过混合重采样（HR）将残差重采样拆分到设备端公共词表区和服务器端LLM专属区，仅需传输公共词表区分布；增强版X-CoSD-E采用服务器重采样与设备验证（SR-DV），服务器仅发送替换候选及其概率供设备本地验证。两者均保持服务器LLM分布，显著提升生成速度且质量相当。
summary_en: This paper proposes X-CoSD, a lossless and communication-efficient collaborative speculative decoding framework for heterogeneous SLM-LLM vocabularies. Built on hybrid resampling (HR), it splits residual resampling across the device-side common-vocabulary region and the server-side LLM-only region, requiring distribution transmission only for the common region. An enhanced variant, X-CoSD-E, uses server resampling with device verification (SR-DV), where the server sends only replacement candidates and probabilities for local verification. Both provably preserve the server LLM distribution and significantly improve token generation speed while maintaining comparable quality.
